description:
FastrackPay allows customers and companies to deploy custom smart wallets for one-click payments or subscriptions via a hosted checkout page. Users can log in with Web3Auth, select a customer or company account, and automatically deploy a linked smart wallet. Companies can create products, manage customer information, and view payment history. Users can fund their accounts with native or ERC20 tokens, providing a PayPal-like experience for crypto payments.

FastrackPay simplifies the integration of crypto payments, making it accessible and efficient for companies and users alike.
how_its_made:
We use an architecture of 3 smart contracts (factory, smart wallet for companies and smart wallet for customers) that users can interact with via web3auth - so that it is possible to login via social accounts instead of using a wallet -, and create their own account (with gas being sponsored through Gelato) 

The contracts interact between them to provide one-time payment & subscription options, for both native and ERC20 tokens.
